# GripConstraintOneAxisEditor

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Interaction` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Interaction/GripConstraintOneAxisEditor.cs#L17)

Inspector and scene handles for [`GripConstraintOneAxis`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/GripConstraintOneAxis).

The two ends of the travel are dragged where the object actually goes, not typed as numbers: a
ghost of the object at each end, and a handle to swing or slide it. A limit typed in is a
number somebody has to convert into a place in their head, and the two only agree until the
pivot moves.

```csharp
[CustomEditor(typeof(GripConstraintOneAxis))]
[CanEditMultipleObjects]
public class GripConstraintOneAxisEditor : VRFComponentEditor
```
